_comment: analytics wave: the Analytics tab on the Dashboard plus the three share cards it can hand to the share sheet. 12 new shareStats.card.* keys (three card titles, the present-tense window line, the saved and followed labels, the keep note, the country-proportion heading and its remainder segment, the flag-grid overflow chip, the pace scale heading and its hour tick), 8 new analytics.* keys for the screen chrome, and forYou.subTabAnalytics for the sub-tab. Pure ADD: every key is new, so no --allow-overwrite is needed. Nothing is renamed or removed, because the splice script only adds and a key that loses its consumer is a permanent orphan in all 20 dictionaries. The window line 'Last 30 days', the empty-state title and every figure label that already existed (countriesLabel, publicationsLabel, openedLabel, openedPartial, latency*, privacyLine) are reused rather than re-minted. flagsMore and hoursShort interpolate {{n}}, NOT {{count}}: neither is ever asked to render 1 (the overflow chip only appears at two or more, a single overflow renders its own flag, and the scale ticks are 0 and 48), so they stay out of i18next plural resolution and away from the six-category CLDR fan-out latencyValue needs. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand.
